newsitem.title: USA: Negotiated cobalt sale outcome by March 10 - DLA.
newsitem.headline: Negotiated cobalt sale outcome by March 10 - DLA.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile will announce the outcome of its sale of 1.1 million pounds of cobalt, offered on a negotiated bid basis, by mid-March.
The deadline for the bidding was February 20, and Richard Connelly, stockpile administrator, said the outcome should be made public by March 10.
He declined to comment on the number of bids received.
Some of the usual bidders have declined to step in the ring because the quality of the material on offer is lower than usual, below 90 percent cobalt.

Earlier on Wednesday, the stockpile announced it was inviting bids on a sealed basis for 1 million pounds of higher grade metal, 93 to 96 percent cobalt. The deadline for accepting bids of this separate offer is March 31.
